title: Live Groq: 27 of 60 sampled open rows got a confident wrong answer (right 15, safe 7, wrong 38)
what_happens: On the 60-row stratified open sample, 38 rows were wrong and 27 of those were confident (e.g. TANGEDCO rundown became a compare, Chennai-wide fire question answered none, Tondiarpet report with wrong period).
what_should_happen: Right or an honest clarify; never a confident answer about the wrong thing.
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main; set QA_P4_PACE=1&& set QA_P4_MODE=live&& set QA_P4_SET=open&& set QA_P4_LABEL=open-baseline-groq&& set QA_P4_SAMPLE=60&& set QA_P4_SEED=20261106&& npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4-live.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/grader/run.test.ts
skeptic_why: Evidence file recounts exactly (right 15, safe 7, wrong 38, confident_wrong 27; reasons are real grader checks such as wrong action/scope/figures). Fresh live Groq re-run of 12 of the same rows (docs/qa/pass4/results/skeptic-groq.json): 10 wrong, 9 confident wrong, 1 right; same rows wrong as before, plus 3 that were right/safe before. Caveat: 17 of 60 rows are code lanes, not Groq (e.g. Tondiarpet last month answered as last 30 days), so wrong is not all the model. Runner is in-process, so port 3191 was not used. Severity P0 stands (confident wrong answer).

title: The runner counts per-minute token limit as no-model and shows Thinking only
